denominator: All preserved original assay cutoffs per reactor, independent of target value/null/SEM/review flags; measures support at supplied assay sampling design
development_folds: Leave one entire development experiment out; explicit inner leave-one-experiment-out train groups
interval: entire supplied original assay acquisition schedule per reactor
limitations: Favors well-supported inputs; not population-representative selection
One final group per mode cannot quantify within-mode generalization variance
Prospectively reserved internal evaluation after all-group exploration, not untouched external validation
ranking: Within each mode maximize minimum of the two exact integer coverage fractions; tie lexicographic experiment ID
